title: 日本ダービーの後に・まばゆい背中

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin comes out on top at the Japanese Derby, but she collapses from sheer exhaustion after the fierce race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket and Biwa Hayahide visit her afterward and are relieved to see that she's okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They each declare their intent to win the final race in the Triple Crown tour—the Kikuka Sho—and depart from the room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket and Biwa Hayahide's overwhelming determination leaves Narita Taishin in awe.
